name: Museum curator
source: The curator of the museum in Nondescriptville. A sympathetic person who values honesty, but can be quite strict if he thinks he is being deceived. [spoiler]Makes Daisy model naked in place of the museum's realistic Neolithic Woman model if she tries to avoid taking responsibility for accidentally breaking it.[/spoiler]
